resources.string: You can play the sample and view network status immediately. To add local music, choose the files in the system picker.
Open Stride to play the sample beat or import your own music. Relay shows your connection. You can change the language and appearance in More.
Read to the end to continue.

Stride saves your library, playback position and speed on this device. The sample beat and local audio play offline. Importing a NetEase playlist or streaming a track contacts the music service.\n\nRelay reads the Wi-Fi radio state and connection type from Android. This preview does not capture the screen or change networks. Language and appearance are stored on your device.
This page shows the network your phone is using. Streaming music on mobile data may use your data allowance.

1.1.0
The tabs are now Loop, Relay, Roam, Stride and More. Roam is reserved for iOS. More can check for updates to this edition, manually or at launch.

1.0.2-preview

All four pages use the blue theme. Stride brings speed, the current track and playback together. Relay shows the system network status.
Tap the highlighted Stride tab to try the player.
Slide across the highlighted speed control and watch the number change.
Tap More below. You can reopen this guide there anytime.
Open Stride to play music. You can find this guide and QQ group 934139029 in More.
